title: Lead conversion to a Partner Referral Opportunity with products

cases.title: Converting a Partner Referral Lead creates a Person Account and a Partner Referral Opportunity at Qualification
The converted Opportunity has exactly the Lead's utilities as products
The Opportunity carries agency, agent, Referral and move-in date; the Referral links to it
A rep can delete a product that will not be connected before Utilities Connected
200 Leads converted together each get the right products and fields
Converting a Lead of another record type runs none of this logic
A Lead owned by a Standard User sales rep (PR_Sales_Rep) converts to a Person Account and Partner Referral Opportunity when converted as that rep (System.runAs)
